question: Should maintainers close this stale branch in favor of a fresh fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46894, or ask the contributor to refresh it against current main?
rationale: The underlying bug is real, but this PR is stale, conflicting, proof-blocked, and semantically too broad; closing one half of the same-author issue/PR pair should be an explicit maintainer cleanup choice.

options.title: Close and replace with a fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede this stale branch, preserve the linked issue as canonical, and land one narrow current-main implementation with proof.

options.title: Ask the author to refresh
options.body: Keep the PR open while requesting a rebase to the moved executor path, corrected list/status behavior, and real UI proof.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the stale PR open without action, accepting that the canonical issue remains blocked on a conflicting, unproven branch.

recommendation.title: Close and replace with a fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this stale branch, preserve the linked issue as canonical, and land one narrow current-main implementation with proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI model-command work makes this the strongest available owner for choosing the current-main fix path.
